overall: The AG found the Everett Licensing Board violated the OML by letting the City Solicitor respond to a complaint on June 21, 2021 without first meeting to review it; the later Sept. 27 review did not cure the untimely response.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to meet to review an Open Meeting Law complaint before the City Solicitor responded to it on the Board's behalf.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it did not first meet to review the complaint before the City Solicitor responded.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements (the Board must meet to review OML complaints and authorize any response before it is sent).
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
